label: 'the user message' is a referent ambiguity, not a contradiction: the target text travels in the wire user role (adapters.ts:101-102) while the transcript user message is separately selected as bounded context (selector.ts:56,70-74); the target was wrapped as a completed assistant message upstream (local-projection.ts:60,91)

COPY_EDITING_INSTRUCTION is defined verbatim at two sites in one package (local-provider.ts:64-65 and external-cli-projection.ts:38-39), so the wording standard already has two homes before any new wording knowledge is added

Plausible provider mistakes: rewrite the context user message instead of the target (if the context text is in-request), mis-attribute authorship because the target block carries no marker under role user, or drop content it believes is out of the 'only the user message' scope; context-text transmission remains untraced

Transform-layer split: mechanical detectors are colon-before-clause excluding >=3-item lists (STYLE.md:27), banned lexemes (STYLE.md:69), and not-X-but-Y pattern (STYLE.md:39); verbless-fragment detection is a finite-verb heuristic carrying the parenthetical/dash exception (STYLE.md:35); stacked compression is fully judgment because adjacency depends on metaphor and nominalization detection (STYLE.md:41-43)

Repairs are where determinism breaks even when detection is mechanical: colon repair chooses a connector, fragment repair merges into a chosen host sentence, and antithesis repair decides whether the contrast is genuine

The fidelity validator cannot host style enforcement: every failed check returns the exact original (validator.ts:372-412), so a style post-condition would trade a style defect for total loss of the rewrite; the reject-only judge emits no style signal at all (reject-only-judge.ts:7-8,21-27)

Style rules are orthogonal to the existing checks: compareSemanticMeaning covers fact, polarity, requirement strength and priority (semantics.ts:62-95), none of which sees a colon-hinged sentence or a nominalization, so a transform layer is additive capability
Fail-closed acceptance: any failed fidelity check on the return path discards the candidate and returns the exact original
Copy-editing scope is assistant-message-only in the prompt contract record, while the wire request carries the target in the user role
Prompt assembly path (contracts/prompt.ts, providers/controls.ts) carries no context-text field; only temperature and thinking controls are compiled there
Bounded context selection output carries selectedText (selector.ts:53,127) and is built by the external CLI runtime (external-cli-projection.ts:76,184), but its route into the wire body is untraced
Policy contract requires the selected context message to be role user with isMeta false (validate-policy.ts:382-387)
